document.title: Top 5 products by units sold from delivered orders between 2025-04-01 and 2025-06-30; return product_id and units, ties

queries.question: Top 5 products by units sold from delivered orders between 2025-04-01 and 2025-06-30; return product_id and units, ties by product_id ascending. Show the top-five ranking as a donut chart.

document.description: Top 5 products by units sold from delivered orders between 2025-04-01 and 2025-06-30; return product_id and units, ties by product_id ascending. Show the top-five ranking as a donut chart.

results.question: Top 5 products by units sold from delivered orders between 2025-04-01 and 2025-06-30; return product_id and units, ties by product_id ascending. Show the top-five ranking as a donut chart.

payload.sql: SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM commerce.order_items AS oi JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY units_sold DESC, oi.product_id ASC LIMIT 5
